business-system-map.code:
EDGES = [
    ("okta", "salesforce"),
    ("okta", "netsuite"),
    ("okta-groups", "salesforce"),
    ("salesforce", "jira-approvals"),
    ("jira-approvals", "audit-export"),
    ("netsuite", "audit-export"),
    ("audit-export", "board-report"),
    ("audit-export", "access-review"),
]

def blast_radius(edges, start):
    adj = {}
    for a, b in edges:
        adj.setdefault(a, []).append(b)
    seen = set()
    frontier = [start]
    while frontier:
        node = frontier.pop()
        for nxt in adj.get(node, []):
            if nxt not in seen:
                seen.add(nxt)
                frontier.append(nxt)
    return sorted(seen)

for broken_edge in [("okta", "salesforce"), ("netsuite", "audit-export")]:
    src, dst = broken_edge
    radius = blast_radius(EDGES, dst)
    affected = sorted(set([dst] + radius))
    print(f"boundary broken: {src}->{dst}")
    print(f"blast radius ({len(affected)}): {', '.join(affected)}")
governance_blind = "access-review" in blast_radius(EDGES, "salesforce") + ["salesforce"]
print(f"governance inside radius of salesforce break: {governance_blind}")

approval-flow.code:
EVENTS = [
    ("request",  "REQ-882", "priya", "billing-admin"),
    ("approve",  "REQ-882", "t.mensah"),
    ("provision","REQ-882"),
    ("request",  "REQ-883", "sam",   "billing-admin"),
    ("provision","REQ-883"),
    ("deny",     "REQ-883", "t.mensah"),
    ("provision","REQ-883"),
    ("approve",  "REQ-999", "nobody"),
]

def process_events(events):
    requests = {}
    decisions = {}
    audit = []
    granted = []
    for ev in events:
        kind = ev[0]
        if kind == "request":
            _, req_id, user, ent = ev
            requests[req_id] = (user, ent)
        elif kind in ("approve", "deny"):
            _, req_id, approver = ev
            if req_id not in requests:
                audit.append(f"ERROR {kind} on unknown {req_id}")
                continue
            decisions[req_id] = (kind, approver)
        elif kind == "provision":
            _, req_id = ev
            decision = decisions.get(req_id)
            if decision is None:
                audit.append(f"BLOCKED {req_id}: no recorded decision")
                continue
            verdict, approver = decision
            if verdict == "deny":
                audit.append(f"BLOCKED {req_id}: denied by {approver}")
                continue
            user, ent = requests[req_id]
            audit.append(f"GRANT {req_id}: {user}+{ent} approved by {approver}")
            granted.append(f"{user}+{ent}")
    return audit, sorted(granted)

audit, granted = process_events(EVENTS)
for line in audit:
    print(line)
print(f"provisioned: {', '.join(granted) if granted else '(none)'}")

TICKETS = {
    "TKT-3401": {"opened": 100, "decision": ("approve", "t.mensah", 238)},
    "TKT-3390": {"opened": 5000, "decision": ("approve", "r.kim", 5100)},
    "TKT-3405": {"opened": 300, "decision": ("deny", "t.mensah", 360)},
    "TKT-3410": {"opened": 400, "decision": None},
}

GRANTS = {
    "grant-5512": {"user": "priya", "ent": "billing-admin", "ticket": "TKT-3401", "t": 239},
    "grant-5490": {"user": "priya", "ent": "sso-admin",     "ticket": "TKT-3390", "t": 20},
    "grant-5520": {"user": "sam",   "ent": "billing-ro",    "ticket": "TKT-3405", "t": 361},
    "grant-5530": {"user": "lee",   "ent": "crm-admin",     "ticket": None,       "t": 500},
    "grant-5531": {"user": "ana",   "ent": "wiki-admin",    "ticket": "TKT-3410", "t": 460},
    "grant-5540": {"user": "raj",   "ent": "crm-ro",        "ticket": "TKT-9999", "t": 600},
}

def verify_chains(tickets, grants):
    out = []
    for gid in sorted(grants):
        g = grants[gid]
        tid = g["ticket"]
        if tid is None:
            out.append(f"{gid}: BROKEN no ticket reference")
            continue
        ticket = tickets.get(tid)
        if ticket is None:
            out.append(f"{gid}: BROKEN dangling ticket {tid}")
            continue
        decision = ticket["decision"]
        if decision is None:
            out.append(f"{gid}: BROKEN no decision on {tid}")
            continue
        verdict, approver, decided_at = decision
        if verdict == "deny":
            out.append(f"{gid}: BROKEN granted despite deny on {tid}")
            continue
        if g["t"] < ticket["opened"]:
            out.append(f"{gid}: BROKEN grant precedes ticket {tid}")
            continue
        if g["t"] < decided_at:
            out.append(f"{gid}: BROKEN grant precedes approval on {tid}")
            continue
        out.append(f"{gid}: OK {tid} approved by {approver}")
    return out

verdicts = verify_chains(TICKETS, GRANTS)
broken = 0
for v in verdicts:
    print(v)
    broken += ("BROKEN" in v)
print(f"population: {len(verdicts)} grants, {broken} broken chains")

# Solution: the three-proof-layer pattern scorer.
# Two candidates arrive pre-scored. Two carried only a scenario — their layer
# scores are judged below against the rubric, one justification per score.
PATTERNS = [
    {"name": "hand-grant-from-queue", "decision": 1, "operational": 0, "transfer": 1,
     "scenario": "A fulfillment agent reads the approved ticket and clicks the grant "
                 "by hand in each app's admin console. Nothing but the agent's "
                 "diligence links the approval to the grant.",
     "named_failure": "agent skips queue under load; ghost access, found only at review"},

    {"name": "ticket-calls-app-api",
     # decision=2 -> enforced by a mechanism, but the ticket system is now a SECOND
     #               place entitlements can be created; the constraint said ONE.
     # operational=1 -> a 200 with an empty body fails silently; nothing surfaces it
     #               until the next quarterly review diffs roles against approvals.
     # transfer=1 -> each new app needs its own hand-written client, auth and retries.
     "decision": 2, "operational": 1, "transfer": 1,
     "scenario": "On approval the ticket system calls the app's REST API directly and "
                 "marks the ticket fulfilled on HTTP 200. Last quarter the vendor "
                 "rotated the API version and the grant endpoint began returning 200 "
                 "with an empty body; tickets kept closing, no grants landed, and the "
                 "gap surfaced at the quarterly access review. Each new app needs its "
                 "own hand-written client, auth and retry logic.",
     "named_failure": "fulfilled ticket with no grant behind it after silent API change"},

    {"name": "event-to-iga",
     # decision=3 -> the IGA is the only thing that touches entitlements, and every
     #               hop (event, execution, write-back) leaves a row.
     # operational=3 -> a failed grant parks in a dead-letter queue an admin owns and
     #               the ticket reads FAILED, not fulfilled, the moment it happens.
     # transfer=3 -> a tenth app is one more connector on the same chain.
     "decision": 3, "operational": 3, "transfer": 3,
     "scenario": "Ticket approval emits an event; the IGA executes the grant and writes "
                 "the result back onto the ticket. The IGA is the only system that "
                 "touches entitlements. A failed grant parks in a dead-letter queue an "
                 "on-call admin owns, and the ticket reads FAILED the moment it happens. "
                 "A tenth app is one more IGA connector on the same chain.",
     "named_failure": "IGA connector backlog delays grants; visible in dead-letter queue"},

    {"name": "shared-admin-spreadsheet", "decision": 0, "operational": 0, "transfer": 0,
     "scenario": "A shared spreadsheet of who-has-what, updated on the honour system.",
     "named_failure": "no enforcement, no evidence; the spreadsheet IS the drift"},
]

WEIGHTS = {"decision": 2, "operational": 3, "transfer": 2}

def score_pattern(p):
    return sum(p[layer] * w for layer, w in WEIGHTS.items())

def select_pattern(patterns):
    lines = []
    best = None
    best_score = -1
    for p in patterns:
        if p["operational"] == 0:
            lines.append(f"{p['name']}: DQ — fails: {p['named_failure']}")
            continue
        s = score_pattern(p)
        lines.append(f"{p['name']}: {s} — fails: {p['named_failure']}")
        if s > best_score:
            best_score = s
            best = p["name"]
    return best, lines

# ── fixed harness (do not edit) ──────────────────────────────────────────
for p in PATTERNS:
    for layer in ("decision", "operational", "transfer"):
        if p[layer] is None:
            raise SystemExit(f"unscored: {p['name']}.{layer} — read the scenario and judge it")
        if not 0 <= p[layer] <= 3:
            raise SystemExit(f"out of range: {p['name']}.{layer} must be 0-3")

winner, lines = select_pattern(PATTERNS)
for line in lines:
    print(line)
print(f"selected: {winner}")

# structural rules your table must satisfy — whatever you scored:
dq = [p["name"] for p in PATTERNS if p["operational"] == 0]
eligible = [score_pattern(p) for p in PATTERNS if p["operational"] != 0]
assert winner not in dq, "a disqualified pattern cannot win"
assert eligible.count(max(eligible)) == 1, "winner must be unique — re-judge until one leads"
print(f"structural rules hold: {len(dq)} DQ, unique winner among {len(eligible)} eligible")

PATH_DATA = {
    "sso-group":      {"source": "saml-group-export-jul02", "rows": ["u"+str(i) for i in range(1, 143)]},
    "local-accounts": {"source": "app-user-export-jul02",   "rows": ["local-adm1","local-adm2","local-adm3","local-adm4","local-adm5","local-adm6","local-adm7","local-adm8","local-adm9"]},
    "api-keys":       {"source": "key-registry-jul02",      "rows": ["key-11","key-14","key-17","key-21","key-28","key-31"]},
}

SYSTEM_MAP = ["sso-group", "local-accounts", "api-keys", "vendor-support"]

def build_report(path_data, system_map):
    lines = []
    total = 0
    for path in sorted(path_data):
        entry = path_data[path]
        count = len(entry["rows"])
        total += count
        lines.append(f"{path}: {count} via {entry['source']}")
    gaps = sorted(p for p in system_map if p not in path_data)
    return lines, total, gaps

lines, total, gaps = build_report(PATH_DATA, SYSTEM_MAP)
for line in lines:
    print(line)
print(f"true population across counted paths: {total}")
for g in gaps:
    print(f"COMPLETENESS GAP: {g} — path exists in system map, report cannot count it")
print(f"report status: {'CONTROLLED' if not gaps else 'PARTIAL — ' + str(len(gaps)) + ' uncounted path(s)'}")

grc-evidence.code:
CONTROLS = [
    {"name": "C-14 termination-revocation",
     "artifacts": ["constraint", "rejected-option", "failure-case", "repair-record", "residual-risk"]},
    {"name": "C-07 access-approval",
     "artifacts": ["constraint", "rejected-option", "success-run"]},
    {"name": "C-21 audit-log-retention",
     "artifacts": ["success-run"]},
    {"name": "C-09 quarterly-access-review",
     "artifacts": ["constraint", "rejected-option", "failure-case", "repair-record", "stricter-scenario"]},
]

def assess_control(control):
    a = set(control["artifacts"])
    missing = []
    if not ({"constraint", "rejected-option"} <= a):
        missing.append("decision")
    if not ({"failure-case", "repair-record"} <= a):
        missing.append("operational")
    if not (("stricter-scenario" in a) or ("residual-risk" in a)):
        missing.append("transfer")
    missing.sort()
    if not missing:
        status = "AUDIT-READY"
    elif len(missing) == 3:
        status = "POLICY-ONLY"
    else:
        status = "PARTIAL"
    return status, missing

ready = 0
for c in CONTROLS:
    status, missing = assess_control(c)
    ready += (status == "AUDIT-READY")
    print(f"{c['name']}: {status}")
    if missing:
        print(f"  missing: {', '.join(missing)}")
print(f"portfolio: {ready}/{len(CONTROLS)} audit-ready")

INCIDENTS = [
    {"iid": "INC-31", "app": "finance-saas",
     "evidence": [("idp", "confirms"), ("finance-saas", "confirms"), ("audit-log", "confirms")]},
    {"iid": "INC-32", "app": "crm",
     "evidence": [("idp", "confirms")]},
    {"iid": "INC-33", "app": "analytics",
     "evidence": [("idp", "confirms"), ("audit-log", "confirms")]},
    {"iid": "INC-34", "app": "billing",
     "evidence": [("idp", "confirms"), ("billing", "contradicts"), ("audit-log", "confirms")]},
]

def evaluate_containment(incidents):
    lines = []
    for inc in incidents:
        iid = inc["iid"]
        contradicting = [s for s, v in inc["evidence"] if v == "contradicts"]
        confirming = [s for s, v in inc["evidence"] if v == "confirms"]
        if contradicting:
            lines.append(f"{iid}: BLOCKED — {contradicting[0]} contradicts containment")
            continue
        if len(confirming) < 2:
            lines.append(f"{iid}: OPEN — {len(confirming)} confirming source(s), need 2")
            continue
        if inc["app"] not in confirming:
            lines.append(f"{iid}: OPEN — no confirmation from {inc['app']} itself")
            continue
        lines.append(f"{iid}: CLOSED — confirmed by {', '.join(confirming)}")
    return lines

lines = evaluate_containment(INCIDENTS)
closed = 0
for line in lines:
    print(line)
    closed += line.split(": ")[1].startswith("CLOSED")
print(f"closed: {closed}/{len(lines)} — the rest stay open on evidence, not optimism")
